segmentler.metin: Saudia Flight 163 landed after a cargo fire, but no one escaped.
It took only a fire in the aft cargo hold after take-off.
So how could a fire in the aft cargo hold after take-off do this?
The answer is cabin fire and smoke with evacuation never started after landing — and it is why airlines stressed immediate evacuation after landing with a fire.
